rounds.text: Aritas Vinyl Ltd is currently priced at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, trading at a price-to-book ratio of only 0.45x [E2]. This valuation is further underscored by a modest P/E ratio of 5.18, suggesting that the market is assigning a very low multiple to the company's earnings [E1]. Despite this depressed valuation, the business has demonstrated strong operational momentum with a 25% compounded sales growth rate over the last three years [E8]. The company maintains respectable profitability metrics, evidenced by an ROE of 12.6% and an ROCE of 11.6% [E6, E7]. Conceded: the stock is currently trading at its 52-week low and offers no dividend yield to shareholders [E4, E5]. Given the combination of double-digit returns on capital and consistent top-line expansion, the current market capitalisation of ₹ 24.6 Cr appears to overlook the underlying growth trajectory of the firm [E3, E6, E8].
